overview: A Waze-style GPS app that records your trips, saves them as routes, and guides you live on the map with travel modes, street tags and location sharing.
features: Record routes with your device GPS, saving name, distance, duration and timestamped path points
Browse and manage saved routes with mini-map previews
Live real-time positioning on the map when following a saved route
Automatic join-path suggestions with distance and ETA when you are off the route
Travel modes for car, bus, motorcycle, bicycle and walking
Drop tags and notes at exact street points, including traffic signals
Share your live location by link, WhatsApp or the native share sheet
Built-in management panel to add, edit and delete routes, tags and notes
